title: Figure 8: Micrographs of in situ metallic glass matrix composite with dendrites
description: Two grayscale scanning electron micrographs captioned "Figure 8. Microstructure of In Situ Metallic Glass Matrix Composite." Panel (a) shows light-gray ductile crystalline dendrites in a dark glassy matrix (50 µm scale bar); panel (b) shows the composite after plastic deformation with multiple slip steps from shear bands interacting with dendrites (10 µm scale bar). The page continues with 'Mechanical Properties of Composites' text and Equation 1.
